whenToUse: Questions with several possible answers, such as naming or writing copy.
Letting people try again when they don't like an answer.
whenNotToUse: Encouraging different answers to factual questions.
Too many versions pile up (keep only the latest few).
The question itself needs changing (use edit prompt).
